therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CSF1R inhibition to deplete tumor-associated macrophages combined with PD-1 checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reprogramming tumor microenvironment by reducing immunosuppressive macrophages and enhancing T-cell anti-tumor activity

results.effect_size: Cabiralizumab + Nivolumab vs Investigator Choice: HR 1.47 (60% CI: 1.19-1.82); Cabiralizumab + Nivolumab + Gemcitabine vs Investigator Choice: HR 1.00 (60% CI: 0.77-1.30); Cabiralizumab + Nivolumab + 5-FU vs Investigator Choice: HR 0.78 (60% CI: 0.60-1.03)
subgroup_findings: Combination with chemotherapy showed better outcomes than dual immunotherapy alone
safety_signals: Febrile neutropenia in chemotherapy combination arms
results.dose_information: Specified doses on specified days per protocol
